title: ID0432051-DC/Si-D/HR-[MP / P0 170001048] PLC configuration issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: PLC configuration issue
Solution: NA
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-06-18
NOTE FROM TS: PLC looks like it's in Stop mode or similar. Please confirm and check on-site if it's correctly placed.
Symptoms
:
no PLC error flags in SCB
only Sicharge-cp error flags in SCB
orange and red PLC [KF1] LED flashing
Rootcause
:  PLC is in Stop Mode or PLC, doesn't change state from STOP to RUN.
Troubleshoot
:
Option A : check dip switch at KF1
Option B :
ET200 baseunits (-KF2 ... -KF9) are not connected to backplane properly
all LEDs of KF2 ... KF9 are OFF
Or there might be a gap between KF1 and KF2
Solution :
Option A : Set dip switch to RUN
Option B :
check every unit for proper assembly and push towards charger
Push on the server module but pushing -KF9 from right to left

Hi Colleagues,
I just got a question from L3 support.
Please check the PLC inside the charger and make a photo about it.
There is a small switch which must be in run status.
If you have opened the door, and turned the PLC into run position, before you shut the door of the cabinet, you will have an option to restart the charger from the screen.
Please if you see the switch in run status, put it into stop position then 5 seconds later to turn it back to run.
Please let me know when you are ready with this procedure.
